name: IC Memory — 3.3V, SPI, 1.8V — SOIC
description: Surface-mount SOIC memory IC cluster supporting SPI communication with 1.8V and 3.3V facets, featuring Tier A symbol MB85RS2MT.
selection_hints: Select for surface-mount memory IC applications requiring a SOIC package, such as SOIC-8_5.3x5.3mm_P1.27mm.
Choose when requiring SPI bus communication with 1.8V or 3.3V operating facets.
Use when requiring Tier A rated KiCad memory symbols such as MB85RS2MT.
avoid_when: Avoid when the board layout requires pin-through-hole mounting or package families other than SOIC.
Do not use if the system requires non-SPI interfaces or operating voltage facets other than 1.8V or 3.3V.
Avoid if a specific memory density or electrical rating not stated in the cluster facts is required.
